title.en: An Act Declaring January 22 of Each Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the City of Vigan, Ilocos Sur to Commemorate Its Anniversary as a City

text.en: January 22 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in the City of Vigan, Ilocos Sur to commemorate its anniversary as a city.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days from its publication in at least two newspapers of general circulation in the Philippines.
